create_embeddings_batch: create an EmbeddingsBatch from source and target SONAR embedding sequences with padding masks
prepare_lcm_input: prepare an LCMInput batch with source and target sequences for supervised or unsupervised training
prepare_target_mask: prepare a target mask for next sentence prediction with configurable minimum context size
flatten_embeddings_to_sentences: flatten a batched embeddings tensor from B,S,D shape to B times S,D after removing padded positions
double_embedding_sequences: double embedding sequences by repeating each element for diffusion model training with repeated targets
